functions.name: update-employee-access-roles
functions.description: Replace an employee's assigned access-role set. This administrative action can grant or remove access.

roleIds.description: Complete desired set of assignable role IDs; empty requests removal of all assignable roles. Retained roles keep existing custom scope settings.

employeeId.description: Opaque employee identifier whose assignments will change.

FunctionInput_leapsome_updateemployeeacc.description: Employee and complete desired ordinary access-role assignment set.

roleIds.description: Desired role IDs accepted by the provider; not a claim about implicit/system roles.

tags.instructions: Obtain employeeId from `list-employees` and role IDs from `list-access-roles`. Supply the entire desired role set, not just additions. functions.name: upload-employee-document
functions.description: Upload a file to the documents associated with a specified Leapsome user. This transfers file bytes rather than importing structured business records.

userId.description: Opaque identifier of the user whose documents will receive the file.

fileName.description: Original file name, including its extension when applicable. Supply a name, not a filesystem path.

mediaType.description: File MIME type, such as application/pdf; used to describe the original bytes.

categoryId.description: Opaque document-category identifier, if a specific category is desired. Omit to use the provider's default categorization, subject to validation of category requirements.

contentBase64.description: Standard padded base64 of the exact nonempty file bytes, with no whitespace or data-URL prefix. Decoded size must not exceed 1,048,576 bytes (1 MiB).

FunctionInput_leapsome_uploademployeedoc.description: One file and the Leapsome user whose document collection should receive it.

userId.description: Opaque identifier of the user to whom the accepted upload was addressed.

uploaded.description: True only when the provider confirms upload acceptance. Does not establish notification, delivery, or absence of duplicates.

documentId.description: Opaque identifier of the uploaded document, included only if returned by the provider.

FunctionOutput_leapsome_uploademployeedo.description: Confirmed upload acceptance and the document identifier when Leapsome returns one.

tags.instructions: Use this tool to attach a document to a known user. Obtain the user's opaque identifier from your employee records first. Supply the original file's bytes as base64, not base64 of a URL. The tool accepts one file of at most 1 MiB per call. Supply a category identifier only if you have one from the account's document categories. A successful result establishes upload acceptance, not recipient notification or delivery. Repeating an upload may create another document; after an ambiguous result, check the user's documents in Leapsome before retrying.
